name: reach
_why_name: Synthetic one-step module profile for scripts/selftest.d/reach.sh. It exists so the module-profile source of `reach --images` is exercised against data rather than against an absent file, and so a Terra-flavoured binding (`workspace.<key>`, a value the tree cannot see) has to be reported as UNRESOLVED with a reason instead of being quoted back as an image. Nothing here is a real module, step or workspace attribute.
